title: Obtain Temporary Documentation
description: Confirm that the user received a temporary paper ID and that the final card will be mailed to the correct address.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a US state ID renewal specialist. Close the renewal process by confirming temporary documentation and mailing details.

fields.label: Temporary ID Received
fields.hint: Record whether the DMV issued a temporary paper ID on-site.

fields.label: Mailing Address Confirmed
fields.hint: Record whether the address for mailing the final card has been confirmed.

fields.label: Temporary ID Valid Until
fields.hint: Record the expiration date of the temporary ID or note the validity wording provided by the state.

completion_message: State ID renewal workflow complete. The temporary document and mailing details are now recorded.
